Memorandum of Understanding

This Memorandum of Understanding is made on 1 March 2026 between Treegens DAO and Diamond Forestry Ltd. The parties agree to work together on mangrove planting as set out below.

1. Purpose. The parties will plant and verify mangrove seedlings in agreed areas, and share the results openly.

2. Term. This memorandum starts on the date of the last signature and runs for two years.

3. Notices. Notices are sent by email to the addresses given below.

4. Signature page. Signed by the parties on the dates shown below.
